headline: RBI MPC Meet: Will your home and car loan EMI rise or fall? RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra to make a major announcement tomorrow at 10 am
summary: The Reserve Bank of India's Governor Sanjay Malhotra will announce a repo rate decision on Thursday at 10 am. Speculation points to a possible rise in home loan EMIs after four consecutive meetings.
why: The Reserve Bank of India sets the benchmark repo rate that anchors borrowing costs across the Indian economy and influences rupee-denominated bond yields.
why_moved: The decision is pending and the input notes expectations of a possible EMI increase amid crude price and inflation pressure. The outcome is not yet known.
